action.public_message: I'm starting an auction for North Carolina Avenue. Let's see what the market says!
action.private_thought: I have $335 cash, price $300. Buying would leave me with only $35, too low to survive upcoming rents, especially Beta's orange monopoly. Starting an auction lets me try to win the property for cheap (max $35) since others likely aren't interested in green. I'll bid up to $35 and hope no one outbids me.
